summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.38/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.38 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 19, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since May 19. AAA figures put the statewide average 36¢ higher than a week ago, 54¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.52 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($4.21) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.51).
